source.author: Vibha Ramprakash
source.note: Starter effects. Every effect gets face tracking and a person cut-out; "face" in needs means it is placed relative to the face, "segmentation" means it hides behind you.

captionZone.rule: captions are composited after the effects, so camera moves never zoom them; "off" effects hide captions for their window automatically; "check" effects need a check frame

moments.claim: The key promise or bold statement.
moments.reveal: The turn: "here is the thing", the answer.
moments.proof: A number, a result, social proof.
moments.cta: The ask at the end: comment, follow, link.
moments.transition: Between sections or at a seam.

energy.high: punch-ins, stamps, glitches, busy card storms

effects.name: noise
effects.does: Your reels (or frames from this clip) pile up behind your head, one every quarter second.

options.images: folder of screenshots or clips (defaults to 10 frames from this video)

effects.captionNote: Cards land anywhere behind you, including behind the caption band; read a check frame for legibility.

effects.name: lineup
effects.does: Numbered tiles fan out in an arc above your head.
effects.captionNote: Sits above the head.

effects.name: locked-on
effects.does: Corner brackets snap onto your face and the camera follows you, with a tag pill under the face.
effects.captionNote: Camera move; captions are added after, so they never zoom.
avoidWith: other camera effects in the same window

effects.name: orbit
effects.does: Your reels circle your head: in front at the bottom, behind you at the top.

options.images: folder of covers (defaults to frames from this clip)

effects.captionNote: The front of the ring passes around chest height; check frames against the caption band.

effects.name: lean-in
effects.does: A fast punch-in on one word.
effects.captionNote: Camera move only.
avoidWith: slow-push or other camera effects in the same window

effects.name: backdrop-word
effects.does: A giant word drops in behind you.
effects.captionNote: Behind the head, above the caption band.
avoidWith: other behind-head words (huge-strike, crayon-write, match-cut, led-sign)

effects.name: spotlight
effects.does: Kills the lights and keeps you lit, with an optional glowing word behind you. look=sparkle (alias glitter-spotlight) adds golden rays and sparkles.
effects.captionNote: Darkens the room; captions stay bright on top.
avoidWith: moody, timeline or other grades in the same window

effects.name: the-bill
effects.does: Prints your instructions like a receipt into the wall above your head.
effects.captionNote: Top of frame.

effects.name: moody
effects.does: A colour grade: darker, softer, teal shadows. grade= moody, bw, warm, cool or pop.
effects.captionNote: Grade only. Works with no face in frame.

effects.name: swipe
effects.does: A before-and-after slider sweeps across you, with a pill label near the bottom.
effects.captionNote: Pill sits at 88% height, below captions; check it doesn't crowd a two-line caption.

effects.name: todo
effects.does: A checklist card beside your head that ticks off as you talk.

options.ticks: video seconds of each tick, joined with |
options.title: default TO DO

effects.captionNote: Sits beside and above the head.

effects.name: comment-box
effects.does: An Instagram comments sheet above your head types your word, posts it, gets a heart and your reply. look=bar for the old bottom bar.

options.handle: your handle (injected from the plan profile)
options.look: bar for the bottom comment bar

effects.captionNote: The default sheet is above the head and safe; look=bar sits at 80% height and needs captions off.

effects.name: tap
effects.does: A Follow button pops up and flips to Following.
effects.captionNote: Default spot is just under the face, near the top of the caption band; set y=0.45 or turn captions off.
avoidWith: another CTA sticker in the same window

effects.name: pause-point
effects.does: Freezes the frame and points at you with a hand-drawn arrow and label.
effects.captionNote: The picture freezes while captions keep moving; keep the window to one short phrase.
avoidWith: camera effects in the same window

effects.name: uninstall
effects.does: A glitchy uninstall bar breaks the frame apart.
effects.captionNote: Bar at 16% height; works with no face.

effects.name: reel-frame
effects.does: Your video shrinks into an Instagram reel card.
effects.captionNote: Captions would float over the card edge; hide them for this window.

effects.name: shortcut-rain
effects.does: Keyboard keys rain down behind you.
effects.captionNote: Behind you; captions stay on top.

effects.name: reject-stamp
effects.does: A big red stamp slams onto the screen.
effects.captionNote: Lands over the chest by default, on top of the caption band; hide captions or set y=0.3.

effects.name: countdown-flip
effects.does: A 3, 2, 1 flip clock above your head.
effects.captionNote: Above the head.

effects.name: rabbit-hole
effects.does: The room tunnels into itself, spinning, while you stay in front.
effects.captionNote: Background only.

effects.name: cover-star
effects.does: You become a magazine cover, with the title behind your head and cover lines down the side. look=editorial for a classic warm cover.
effects.zone: whole frame: masthead top, lines mid-left, barcode bottom
effects.captionNote: Cover lines start at 50% height and run through the caption band.

effects.name: scribble
effects.does: Marker doodles draw themselves around you, with a label and arrow.
effects.captionNote: Doodles stay near the head.

effects.name: glass-widgets
effects.does: Frosted glass widgets and mini artifacts (stats, profile, calendar, render bar) float around your head, with an "Edited by" pill near the bottom. look=simple for 3 widgets.

options.name: profile name (injected from the plan profile)

effects.captionNote: The pill sits at 87% height below captions; widgets can reach chest height. Read a check frame.

effects.name: red-collage
effects.does: Black-and-white you, a giant red word behind, three lines slam in beside you.
effects.zone: whole frame: word top, lines from 50%
effects.captionNote: The kinetic lines run through the caption band.

effects.name: split-headline
effects.does: A headline card slides down and pushes you into the bottom of the frame.
effects.captionNote: You move down, so the caption band ends up over your face; set captionY lower or hide captions.

effects.name: pastel-word
effects.does: A soft lavender room, a giant word behind you and a profile card that gets followed.
effects.zone: whole room + word top + card at 87%
effects.captionNote: The profile card sits below the caption band; check a two-line caption.

effects.name: check-pills
effects.does: Grid-paper room, reel boards pinned behind you and blue pills that a cursor clicks.
effects.captionNote: Pills land between 30% and 90% height; check frames.

effects.name: timeline
effects.does: A dark red cinematic grade with an editing timeline, a REC timecode and a glowing playhead.
effects.captionNote: Read a check frame: the timeline panel can sit near the caption band.

effects.name: headline-box
effects.does: A punch-in with a two-line headline above your head, the second line in a white box.
effects.captionNote: Headline sits above the head; captions stay put.

effects.name: profile-wall
effects.does: Your reels grid fills the wall behind you while a view counter ticks up below your face.
effects.zone: wall behind + counter card below face
effects.captionNote: The counter card lands at chest height, in the caption band.

effects.name: tier-list
effects.does: A tier list drops in front of you and an item flies into S tier.
effects.zone: title above head, board from mid-frame

options.title: question title
options.item: item that lands in S tier (default Claude)

effects.captionNote: The board covers mid-frame and the caption band.

effects.name: broll-split
effects.does: Split screen: b-roll on top with a price-tag sticker, you on the bottom.
effects.zone: top half b-roll, you shifted down

options.images: folder with the b-roll image or clip

effects.captionNote: You move to the bottom, so the caption band may sit on your face; hide captions or check frames.

effects.name: phone-fan
effects.does: Your reels fan out like a hand of phones under a two-line headline.
effects.zone: headline above head, phones from 62% down
effects.captionNote: The phones fill the bottom of the frame, over the caption band.

effects.name: dot-reveal
effects.does: Your shot builds itself out of glowing dots, then snaps into the full picture.
effects.captionNote: Works with no face. Best as the very first effect.
avoidWith: camera effects in the same window

effects.name: headline-wall
effects.does: Your own headlines pile up behind your head, then a total pops in front.
effects.captionNote: The total pill lands at 60% or lower; read a check frame.

effects.name: checklist
effects.does: A task list builds under your chin: each step spins, then ticks green.

options.title: card title (default "Claude is editing your clip")

effects.captionNote: The card sits under the chin, on the caption band.

effects.name: liquid-glass-graph
effects.does: A liquid glass card floats under your chin while a graph climbs and the number counts up. look=bento moves it to a smoked glass screen behind your head with tiles in front.
effects.zone: under chin (bento: behind head + tiles from 50%)
effects.captionNote: The card sits under the chin, on the caption band.

effects.name: carousel-spin
effects.does: Your reels spin around you in a 3D carousel, then slow to a stop.
effects.captionNote: Front cards pass through chest height; check frames.

effects.name: match-cut
effects.does: News pages cut on one word, locked in a red box behind your head.
effects.captionNote: Behind the head.

effects.name: apple-toggles
effects.does: An iPhone settings card flips its switches on, one line at a time. Default sits above you tucked behind your head with a gentle zoom; pos=below puts it under the chin.

options.ticks: seconds of each flip, joined with |

effects.captionNote: Default above-head card is safe. With pos=below, hide captions.

effects.name: led-sign
effects.does: The lights drop and a glowing LED sign types itself out behind you.
effects.captionNote: Behind the head; darkens the room.

effects.name: slow-push
effects.does: A slow cinematic push-in to your face while the room melts out of focus.
effects.captionNote: Camera move; captions stay sharp on top.
avoidWith: other camera effects in the same window

effects.name: over-the-shoulder-zoom
effects.does: The camera pushes into one top corner and a liquid glass graph pops beside your head, pulls back, then the other corner with a second graph.
effects.captionNote: Graphs sit at 25% height.

effects.name: messages
effects.does: iMessage notifications pop in one after another, stacking up just above 61% height.
effects.captionNote: The stack ends just above the caption band; with long captions set y=0.55 or hide captions.

effects.name: place-in-grid
effects.does: You shrink into the centre tile of your 3x3 profile grid, then 8 reels pop in around you with view counts.

options.views: 9 counts joined with |, the 9th is yours

effects.captionNote: Captions would float over the grid.

effects.name: tape-label
effects.does: A level strip of yellow tape with your line lands on your chest.
effects.captionNote: It is a caption-style label on the caption band; hide captions for this window.
avoidWith: stickers or hero captions at the same time

effects.name: select-resize
effects.does: A blue selection box grabs your number above your head and a cursor drags it bigger.
effects.captionNote: Above the head.

effects.name: wave-trim
effects.does: A dark panel above your head shows your voice; the silent ends collapse until only your words are left.
effects.captionNote: Above the head. Works on any speech.

effects.name: huge-strike
effects.does: One huge serif word wipes in behind your head, then a red line crosses it out.

options.at: seconds into the effect when the strike lands, default 0.6

effects.captionNote: Behind the head.

effects.name: crayon-write
effects.does: A red crayon writes your word behind your head, then underlines it and flies off.
effects.captionNote: Behind the head.

effects.name: fan-build
effects.does: Your reel covers deal into a fan behind your head, one card at a time.
effects.captionNote: Behind and above the head.

presets.name: Punchy hook
presets.pace: 4-6 effects, high energy spaced 5 s apart

presets.name: Product demo
presets.for: showing a tool, a result or numbers
